subject: general
question: The first ICC Women's Cricket World Cup was held in the year ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1973**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ICC Women's World Cup:

 
 
• The first tournament was held in England in 1973. 
 
• The first edition was won by England.
 
• Australia holds the most number of titles won in the Women's World Cup.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Cricket: 

 
 
• The first official cricket test match was played in the year 1877 between Australia and England in Melbourne.
 
• The First Day International cricket match was played in the year 1971 between England and Australia in Melbourne.
 
• The first World Cup of one-day matches was played in 1975 in London.
 
• The apex institution of world cricket is the International Cricket Council (ICC) and its headquarters are now in Dubai.
 
 
• Earlier it was in Lords (England).
 
 
 
• The ICC was founded in 1909.
 
• The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) was formed in 1928.
